description: This Java source file defines utility methods for BSON object conversion, extraction, and pretty-printing, specifically tailored for MongoDB BSON objects within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: BsonUtil
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for converting between Bson and BsonDocument, extracting values from BSON documents, and formatting BSON objects as JSON strings.

methods.name: toBsonDocument
methods.description: Converts a Bson object to a BsonDocument, throwing NullPointerException if input is null.

methods.name: toBsonDocumentOrNull
methods.description: Converts a Bson object to a BsonDocument, or returns null if input is null.

methods.name: toBsonDocuments
methods.description: Converts a collection of Bson objects into a list of BsonDocument objects.

methods.name: getRequiredDocumentValueAt
methods.description: Retrieves a value from a Document at the specified key and casts it to the specified class, throwing exceptions if key is missing or type mismatch occurs.

methods.name: getDocumentWithDefaultAt
methods.description: Retrieves a value from a Document at the specified key, or returns a default value if not present.

methods.name: getValueByPath
methods.description: Extracts a nested value from a Bson object using a dot-separated path.

methods.name: prettyPrint
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a collection of Bson objects.

methods.name: prettyPrint
methods.description: Returns a JSON string of a single Bson object.
